hero.description: Electronics engineer and fabricator with hands-on experience in controls, automation, panel design, and low-voltage systems. I build reliable solutions that work.

about.heading: Building things that work.
about.lead: I'm an electronics engineer who takes projects from concept through design, fabrication, testing, and delivery. I combine electronics, controls, automation, and hands-on fabrication to solve real problems.
about.body: My background spans industrial control systems, low-voltage electronics for motorsports, electrical panel design and assembly, and personal projects in metalworking and autobody restoration. I thrive at the intersection of hardware, software, and mechanical systems—whether building electrical panels, developing data pipelines, or learning new fabrication skills.

items.description: Lead low-voltage electrical systems for a university Formula EV team. Manage power distribution, control modules, and sensor integration while coordinating with mechanical and software teams.
Developed data pipelines, automation tools, and technical systems across corrosion monitoring, asset management, and inspection planning for multi-facility operations.
Built electrical panels from design through assembly and QC. Loaded control module software, performed pre-delivery quality assurance, and managed projects from issue to customer delivery.

items.name: Corrosion Monitoring Dashboard
items.description: Built a centralized data pipeline in Microsoft Fabric to automate corrosion coupon tracking across 12 facilities with 100+ monitored assets, replacing manual vendor report processing.

image.alt: AltaGas facility inspection with team members examining equipment

items.name: Inspection Scope Generation Tool
items.description: Developed a Python-based tool using openpyxl and python-docx to automate creation of 500+ equipment-specific inspection scopes from database exports, reducing manual creation time by 95%.

items.name: Heat Exchanger Lifecycle Analysis
items.description: Analyzed 2+ years of operating data for 12+ brazed aluminum heat exchangers to assess fatigue risk, identify monitoring gaps, and recommend operational changes to extend asset life.

items.name: Formula EV Electrical Systems
items.description: Leading low-voltage electrical design and integration for a university Formula EV team, managing power distribution, sensor networks, and control system coordination.

items.name: Control Panel Builds
items.description: Sample control panels from Spartan Controls build work, representing a subset of the 30+ panels assembled, wired, loaded, and checked through pre-delivery QA.

items.name: Leather Tool Carrier
items.description: Designed and built a leather tool carrier while working at Spartan to keep common hand tools organized and accessible during panel assembly and inspection work.

items.name: Fabrication & Metalworking
items.description: Metal fabrication, welding, autobody work, and hands-on problem-solving. I enjoy learning new fabrication techniques and building durable solutions that last.

items.name: Motorsports
items.description: Formula EV racing, vehicle engineering, and pushing the boundaries of what student teams can achieve. Building systems that perform under pressure.

items.name: Woodworking & Design
items.description: Woodworking projects, industrial design, and CAD. I enjoy the process of designing something functional and building it with my hands.

items.name: Community & Volunteerism
items.description: Tour Alberta for Cancer Ride and other community initiatives. Supporting causes I believe in and building stronger teams and communities.

contact.heading: Let's build something.
contact.lead: I'm always interested in engineering projects, new opportunities, and meeting people who like designing and building things. Whether it's automation, electronics, fabrication, or motorsports—let's talk.
